evidence.decision: Decides commands versus a selected value, weighs reveal cost for one/two items and keeps the main task visible with component-specific destructive resolution.
evidence.artifact: Requires visible-primary route, related-command scope and confirmation/cancellation artifact or implementation.
evidence.transformation: Drawing ellipsis stops hiding Save alongside one Duplicate command; Save becomes direct and genuinely secondary work gets an appropriate surface.
evidence.verification: Checks open/select/dismiss, cancellation, labels and object scope; fails hidden-only primaries and unresolved destructive selection.
evidence.applicability: Explicitly scopes iOS action-sheet/iPad popover confirmation and TV/Watch absence; touch-and-hold supplements practical recognizable activation.
evidence.handoffs: Loads Pop-up for a state choice and Action sheets/Popovers/Buttons only for the selected presentation or action branch.
evidence.distinctiveness: Reveal-step value, primary-action discoverability and command consequence determine a pull-down-specific redesign.
